scope.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35213, 64-bit
scope.transport: actual-mobius4-http-through-latency-proxy; edge-b over a forwarded TCP port to the second host
scope.host: edge-a and the orchestrator on a Windows host; edge-b on a second physical host

edgeB.host: Ubuntu 22.04.5 VM (kernel 5.15.0-204) on the lab LAN, hostname sha256 6c013eb7b6f9; Mobius4 4.25.0 container (image 4360aa71cb70) with its own PostGIS 17 database
edgeB.path: SSH port forwarding over the LAN: -L for requests to edge-b, -R for its notifications

scope.sourceRevisionNote: Mobius4 revision pinned in deployment/cse/upstream.json for the 4.25.0 artifact both CSEs ran. The runner had recorded the HEAD of the enclosing repository because the artifact directory is not a git checkout; the field was corrected before publication.

simulation.deviceNote: keyring telemetry generated in-process at a fixed rate (Gateway telemetry schema 1.0.0); no BLE hardware
simulation.locationNote: scripted MEC Location reports through MecPolicyReconciler and approved zone policies
simulation.availabilityNote: edge-a Mobius4 process is terminated (TerminateProcess) and restarted on the same PostgreSQL database
simulation.latency: real probe RTT; extra delay injected by a loopback TCP proxy process
simulation.loadNote: edge-agent load value set by the scenario (simulated report)
simulation.coordinatorStore: run-local in-memory IntegrationStore subclass (shallow collection copy per transaction)
